summary: Frontend Coding Agent verified and refined the production code for NFR-REL-001 (Auto-Save Crash Durability). 7 source files implement the full auto-save crash recovery system: dbSchema.ts (IndexedDB schema with idb typed helpers), persistenceService.ts (atomic dual-store writes, closeSession, quota-exceeded purge), crashRecoveryService.ts (boot-time orphan detection with snapshot validation), persistenceStore.ts (Zustand state management), useAutoSave.ts (beforeunload + interval auto-save), ResumePrompt.tsx (accessible modal with all data-testid attributes), and ResumePrompt/index.ts (barrel export). All 10 TDD test contracts from the frontend-test agent are satisfied.

artifacts.name: IndexedDB Schema
artifacts.description: Database schema types (BrickRecord, CameraState, SceneMetadata, SceneSnapshot, AutoSaveMeta), PersistenceError class, idb-based DB open helper with upgrade logic, constants (DB_NAME, DB_VERSION, CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION)

artifacts.name: Persistence Service
artifacts.description: Atomic dual-store writes (saveSnapshot), closeSession, loadSnapshot, purgeOldSnapshots (keeps latest 10), purgeSession, PersistenceError/PersistenceErrorCode exports

artifacts.name: Crash Recovery Service
artifacts.description: Boot-time crash detection (detectCrash), snapshot validation (bricks array + schema version), acceptRecovery, discardRecovery

artifacts.name: Persistence Store
artifacts.description: Zustand store managing auto-save status (idle/saving/saved/error), session lifecycle, crash recovery UI state, triggerAutoSave/markSessionClosed/checkForCrashRecovery actions

artifacts.name: useAutoSave Hook
artifacts.description: Extended hook with beforeunload listener for graceful close detection and setInterval-based periodic auto-save with overlap guard

artifacts.name: ResumePrompt Component
artifacts.description: Accessible modal dialog with role=dialog, aria-modal=true, aria-labelledby, and all required data-testid attributes (resume-prompt, resume-prompt-brick-count, resume-btn, discard-btn)

artifacts.name: ResumePrompt Barrel Export
artifacts.description: Barrel export for ResumePrompt component and ResumePromptProps type
